# goslop text fixture — constant-assign / return fallback after a JS interop
# stream probe try body (status_text / bytes() shapes)
lang: python
file: js_bridge_constant.py
---
def read_status(js_response):
    try:
        reason = js_response.status_text or ""
        return reason
    except Exception:
        return ""


def read_body(js_response):
    try:
        return js_response.bytes()
    except Exception:
        response_body = b""
        return b""
